verified_files.code_fact: Worker queue config assigns visibilityTimeoutMs: 60000 and retry: { maxAttempts: 5 } to schedule.triggerScheduledTask, sending unhandled errors to DLQ after 5 attempts (~15-30 seconds).
#handleTriggerScheduledTaskJob hardcodes finalAttempt: false ('TODO: implement retry logic'), disabling terminal attempt handling on subsequent retries.
onTriggerScheduledTask invokes triggerService.call without specifying an idempotencyKey in the body or options.

triggerScheduledTask executes onTriggerScheduledTask before calling registerNextTaskScheduleInstance; if registration fails, it checks if (!params.finalAttempt) throw nextRunError, triggering a worker retry of the already-executed trigger.
